reviews.text:
Great Variety of classes. I’ve been practicing yoga for almost 10 years now and I’ve experienced many great yoga teachers over the years. I really like the variety of classes offered by Core power, it allows me to choose what my body needs that day - from high energy to nice flow or to restorative. I also appreciate the different time lengths available on the Demand CP app, from 20 mins to 60 mins. 
Keep up the great job, CP!!!!

No new classes. I love the classes but there have been no new classes in months. And when they do release new classes, it’s like 2 classes only at a time. It is laughable. The lack of new content shows their lack of investment in the app. Maybe they’re focusing more on in studio experiences now post pandemic.
Need new videos!. No new content in months! :-(
Love!. I love having the ability of taking these classes at anytime.
Love this app!. I just love yoga! And this app keeps up with the flow I like. The variety of teachers and classes lengths lets me customized my workout on any given day. Thank you corepower. ❤️
Love tracking my progress. My favorite thing about the CorePower app is how I can track my progress over time to see how many classes I’ve taken.

Just what I was looking for!. I’ve been doing yoga for several years along with weight training and HIIT. Due to over-training injuries, at my age if 62, I needed to find a practice that could give me all the above. CorePower Yoga is just what I was looking for. It is challenging and I’m recovering from injuries safely while not sacrificing my long term goals of strength, flexibility and mobility.

On demand Is great-actually speaking to someone is not. I have used my on demand app daily since Covid. It’s great, gives me a variety of options to choose from so I can vary my workout. And some of the instructors I adore.
 I have a $200 dollar credit from prior Covid, and I am not able to go into a studio anymore. I have called my closest studio asking if I can switch this into paying for my app. And they say I have to contact corporate. Which I have done via email numerous times with no response. When I have called I have just been put on hold for such a long time, I hang up. 
So as long as you don’t have to actually contact anyone with the location part, its great.

Variety & Convenience. Although I love to go to a yoga class in person, it almost always happens that I can’t find one that works with my schedule. But I can always find a class here and knock it out on my own schedule. All I ask is that they have more 45 minutes sessions. There are countless classes but only TWO 45 minute sessions?! Please more 45s and a way to adjust for volume on instructor and/or music. That would be a perfect 5-star app! UPDATE: After reading through tons of reviews, there are clearly several feature requests coming through-ability to favorite a class, better searching ability, music/instructor voice control, and history tracking. So what is CorePower doing on these repeated requests? Any of these things coming in the future? Thanks for any feedback we can get on this!

No new content?. Yes, I love the app but for a subscription-based model I’d appreciate new content with the same pace of the monthly charge. I prefer the one hour workouts but it seems like the last content for 60 minute workouts was generated early 2019. I’ve already gone through all of it so like DVD they should charge a one time fee. View my review as a call to produce newer content especially for 60 minute workouts!

Helpful. There is a large selection of videos available for practice at leisure. It’s diverse & motivating, even if not done in studio. Hoping for more current videos to be uploaded though to get an update on new challenges & asanas. Worth the effort.
Lacks in adding new classes. There have been no new classes added in months

Best yoga app and I’ve tried them all!. Most instructors online talk too much, they mess up the different sides, they spend too much time cueing. Corepower instructors don’t spend too much time talking but the cues they provide are excellent. I’ve tried Peloton and countless other on demand yoga apps, but this is by far the best. Every class I’ve done so far has been excellent.

Accurately executes on what you get in studio classes!. Best on-line content I’ve found because it’s like going to one of their classes. Only you can chose shorter segments too if you don’t have a full hour, or want to work on a particular muscle group. The online instructors are energizing and fun. Just can’t say enough good things - just try it 💗

Glitchy. The app glitches constantly when switching filters to view classes at different studios. Sometimes it take more than ten seconds (I counted) for the class schedule to load only to NOT load the classes for the day of. It’s a bother and I have not gone to classes simply because I am unable to view the schedule. 🤷🏽‍♀️

Corepower on demand app does not provide content as advertised. I have been paying for on CPY on demand app for a few years. In the past 2 months they have not uploaded new on demand content monthly as advertised and relied upon. I have contacted customer service repeatedly and they falsely assert they uploaded new content in July 2022. However, the link they emailed me was for classes uploaded prior to June of 2022. Despite repeated inquiries, they refuse to provide an explanation or content as advertised or credit my account for failure to provide product as advertised and relied upon when I agree to be charged a monthly membership fee.

Great for traveling. Love to be able to take a class anytime . I’m out of town and it’s much easier to get my online class and take the format that I need for the day. 
And I don’t have to find an Uber to drive me there . 
Thank you CorePower for making it possible for us to take classes as we are out of town. 
Andrea Berg

Review. I recommend improving the functionality by allowing a user to sort by class type (YS, C2 etc) and then by duration as well as the newness of the video. It would also be great to sort by focus area legs, arms, booty too.

Need new content. I loved this app through the pandemic but now they seem to have abandoned adding new content. I live in an area without an accessible yoga studio but may need to look for another on demand option and cancel my subscription if they’ve stopped investing in adding content. Very disappointed in what was a 5 star product for the past 2 years.
Lots of variety. I really like the variety of class options. I never have to repeat a class

Workouts great, app could be better. I love Corepower yoga and am so happy to bring the studio into my home as there isn’t one near me. 

The app is usable but I wish it had more ability to feature by length and by trainer. And also to rewind if needed. 

Otherwise, highly recommend. I always feel stronger and more centered after a Corepower class.

Yoga Partner. This particular app has saved me over the past couple of years and I’m all in now. I love that I can take classes with some of the folks I’ve trained under whenever I want that energy (Matt) and I’m “meeting” new teachers I’d love to see more of (Damon & Olivia) for example. I know there’s are lots of CPY teachers but the all stars should be asked back to create more content.

Great app. I truly enjoy practicing yoga with this app. I feel more knowledgeable and strong. I like to be challenge, so I found my place.

Great Classes. I really like the quality classes that I can access at home.
Awesome!. Love the workouts! Great value! Love the selection. All abilities, all levels of intensity. I moved so I could no longer attend classes in person. Thanks!
Perfect. Choice, good instructors, variety of length in time and types. thank you!!!
Love it. Great app. Tons of class options.

Just okay. This app is fine but has not been kept on par with other fitness apps. The interface is almost too simple in terms of sort/filter/search. There is not an easy way to identify which classes I’ve done before. And my biggest issue is that there is no way to turn off the music without losing instructor audio. I’d much prefer to use my own music than what’s available here. Overall, it’s adequate, but not at the same level as the more affordable Peloton or iFit apps.
My go-to for home practice!. High quality sound and video but more importantly these classes are so fun and challenging!!
HPF!!. I have maintained my daily practice threw out Covid JodyM you are my yogi best friend!

Great Variety and Quality. Whether you like to flow to the same set of postures or like to work toward a particular complex posture, this app gives you a great variety of classes, tools, levels, teaching styles, and lengths for you choose what you like, when you like for as long as you like. I used to go to their studios because I like their particular type of yoga, so with the pandemic and the large amount of international travel that I do, the app has been a fantastic way to keep my practice. You don't even need a great internet connection, because you can download the class if you’re going to a remote place with very sparse internet access) as I did during the pandemic).

Love it. A silver lining of COVID is that my company started to offer online fitness classes. I continued after they stopped and found corepower yoga on demand. While I love in person classes, with three small children and working full time this means I can fit yoga in almost every day. No childcare, I can do it after they’re in bed if it’s busy at work, and if I have little time I do the 30 or even 20 minute classes. The teachers are great and the yoga is legit- I’m picky as I’ve practiced for years. Love love love it.
Simply Wonderful!. So many options to accommodate not only my work life but my energy level as well. The instructors are fabulous. Thank you for making this difficult time at home a little sweeter.
Amazing instructors and app!. Fantastic and convenient way to yoga with the best instructors!

Quality app. Excellent app, worth the monthly payment. Diverse videos that give great options for what your goals are. Would like more meditation/yin yoga practices for recovery but slowly see them added.
Amazing!. Love this app. Great content!
Love this app!. Content is fresh - always something new to try!

reviews.text: Great selection and Price (with March $20/month for life of membership deal). I love this service! $20 per month is so affordable and I find this fits in perfectly as my gym membership. There needs to be significantly more core restore classes I love Mary Katherine, but I could use some diversity of poses after months of doing the same practice over and over again.
Core power. As good or better than going to a yoga studio!

Best at home app so far!. Have tried numerous virtual workout platforms over the past year and CorePower has been the best so far! I do the yoga sculpt, both with weights or those without (body weight only) and find them to be a good challenge and great to cross train for hiking. My feedback would be to add new classes more frequently and to consider adding some that are 45 min in length- a happy medium between 30 and 60. The 30 minutes often feel like a better workout than the 60 because they are paced faster, but could use more time to keep the intensity going.

Love the teachers!. I love most of the teachers on the app and love that you can sort through them. Unfortunately, the filters aren’t very useful, they should add more ways to filter so you can get on your mat faster. I’d also appreciate truly 30 minutes classes instead of 20 minutes. Or even 45 minute classes.
Excellent app. Easy to navigate, high quality videos, great instructors!

Positive surprise of COVID this app!. Before the pandemic, I rarely did yoga on video. What I love about the core power app is the consistency of the challenge, the positivity of the teachers, and the ability to continue my workouts in a safe way. Thank you CPY for helping us all stay connected during this time!

Awesome Yoga Classes!. If you are looking for an awesome yoga experience like your in the studio at home, then Core Power On Demand is your place to practice. So many great classes to choose from and practice styles. It’s been such a blessing during the pandemic to recharge and get balanced.🧘‍♀️
Totally worth it!. Awesome way to do yoga every day even if you just do it for 15, 20, 30 min, so great for all around health!

Corepower on Demand. I love this app! I can do yoga anytime, anywhere. I wish there was a feature that let’s you know if you’ve already watched a video on there or not. I find myself clicking on the same ones forgetting that I have already done the class
so glad this is available. I am loving Damon's classes and wish he would make more! I always feel so relaxed after and I love his tone and pace

Amazing teachers. I have no problem giving 5 stars to Core Power On demand and it is because of one word - teachers!! They are all amazing and have so much heart. No new content. I have always loved CPY on demand, but there’s not been any new content in months. I get they want you to do the live classes but that’s not always an option. I won’t be renewing my subscription when it runs out. Very sad.
Helping keep my practice alive!. Thanks CP for this invaluable gift of reconnecting to my practice♥️
Love CorePower On Demand!. Recently started the 14 day sculpt body weight challenge and am loving the mix of classes and teachers! Great workout every time!
Great for our pandemic times. Obviously not the same as attending class in person, but still great. Lots of instructors, variety of classes, and new ones added regularly. Plus 5 minute meditations.
C2 with Kat. Short but sweet...a comprehensive shortened flow!
Great yoga!. High quality just like the in-studio classes!

So many glitches now. This app is frustrating and I’m quite sick of it. Theres times were I’m in the middle of a downloaded video then it just blacks out. All my downloaded videos were not showing up yet took up all the space on my ipad. Im about done with this and getting something else.

Its ruining my practice!!!! Instead of feeling good I get annoyed its always glitching.
Great at home workout option!. I love that there are 20, 30, and 60 minute options and that you can search by instructor! I love Bri L’s classes so much!!

Good, but needs work. I like the offline mode that works completely offline unlike Peleton’s preload feature, but other than that it’s pretty basic and a bit sparse. I really wish you could like instructors or hide instructors you don’t like, and the number of classes per instructor is laughably low. 3 or 4 tops for most instructor per class type. There’s only maybe less than 10 hour long sculpt classes with good intense instructors.

Also being able to filter by class length and relative difficulty would also be nice as there’s lots of 30 min or shorter classes unlike regular core power classes. As far as I’m aware there’s no live classes either.

There’s also a bug where every time I start an offline class about a minute in it’ll force me to restart.

Online is my jam. I have wanted to commit to a yoga practice but have struggled with the lost time to get to a studio regularly. Like everyone there are not enough hours in my day. My daughter encouraged me to try the Core Power online. Finally, I am developing a regular yoga practice routine. I love the options of video length and the variety of routines. I can practice according to my available time and how I feel that day. I love the Core Power on demand option ❤️

reviews.text: Nice app. Lovely for yoga practitioners to practice at home. I’d recommend starting off with a teacher first before getting on the app if you’re new to yoga, but for those of you trying to stay indoors for covid19, great app! I use it everyday
Core power yoga on demand. This is a great app! Good selection of videos. You can pick whatever you are in the mood for. Instructors give good cues and keep you motivated and engaged.

Good workouts but app needs some personalization features. I really enjoy the variety of classes offered. Thank you!. Incorporating daily yoga has changed my life. Corepower yoga gives me the variety to keep me interested and motivated. 🙏❣️👏👏

reviews.text: Yoga whenever you want. The yoga lessons available on demand are amazing. It’s great to be able to select the different level of lessons depending on my day and the needs of my body. I love being able to access these classes. The instructors are amazing. Thank you!!

Great Variety For At Home Practice. I started using CP On-Demand when the pandemic shut my yoga studio down and I was pleasantly surprised at how many classes are available! There’s a great variety of classes from restorative to power flow to sculpt classes with Pilates infused. And I love that there are shorter 20 and 30 min classes for the days when I don’t have time or energy to do a full hour but still want to practice. The only thing I wish was different is I’d love for it to track which clases you’ve done or at least how many classes you’ve done and what days you’ve done them so you can see how frequently you’re practicing. Please add that feature! Besides that, love the classes, love the energy from the teachers, and thank you for keeping my yoga practice alive during this challenging year!

Core Power yoga. This on line yoga has saved my mind and body during this 14 week(going on) pandemic. Been practicing in the studios for years. Now with my mats and cell phone, I can keep it going. Teachers and variety are great and if you know the positions you can follow along even on a 3” screen!!! Thank you to all of core power!

CorePower Yoga lover!. I live in Puerto Rico and there are no corepower yoga studios here. I do practice yoga almost every day.

I had to fly to Kansas City for a job training and stayed in the country club plaza area and discovered there was a yoga studio there. It Corepower yoga studio and I was so happy I was able to practice the 3 weeks I was in Kansas City. 

I was able to take a full week free and I fell in love with the studio, the heated clases and the yoga sculpt classes, the teachers. I brought a monthly pass, I practiced every day for the time in Kansas City. I came back to PR and was very happy to see that that I am able to practice core power classes in the comfort of my home. I wish there is a yoga studi here but, Since Puerto Rico, is very hot and humid, I sweat almost as much as in a heated studio. I am so glad corepower did this app, so people like me who don’t have a studio near , can practice as well. I love the different clases, meditations and teachers. Thank you again!
New classes. I love this option to do core power at home. Only wish you’d put more classes on here a little more often, but understand it’s probably a little tough at this time.

Bri is the best.. Every teachers on the app is amazing. This is absolutely a yoga app not with a the right flow that energizes your body and awakes you’re chakra. Bri is amazing and I wish to have more of her videos: straight to the point through beautiful grace and courageous. Other teachers I found was not captivating as she is.

Great in person alternative. Nothing can replace the in person experience but these classes are fantastic. For a person who is accustomed to the corepower class structure, I can almost pretend I’m actually in class again. Lots of mini session options too! Only have 20 minutes? There’s a class for you!
Best at home workout app!. So many great classes for whatever mood I’m in. It’s just as good as the real studio. Thank you for making these available on demand!

Covid care. Core power yoga classes are my savior during Covid! On demand allows me the flexibility to fit into my work at home schedule. Love the multiple styles and lengths for variety. Teachers are awesome giving you just the right instruction at just the right time? I’m am a yogi for last 25 years and I am new to CORE POWER in COVID and am grateful for this platform!

Needs some minor tweaks..... Pretty good app, especially useful that one now has to reserve ahead of time.

However, it needs a few tweaks:

- Instead of showing a button with “Book” and then telling me the class is at capacity, why not show “join waitlist” right away?

- More importantly, when I’m wait listed, I never know when or if I’ll get admitted. I’m 45 mins away from class time and still waitlisted. At this time, why can’t I “give” up and cancel being on the waitlist? (I would hate to be admitted 10 mins before class and then charged if I have no chance of making it to the studio in time!)

Great option. This is been a great option for me especially during coronavirus and quarantine. I don’t usually do yoga sculpt but this has given me the confidence to do it and re-integrate back into the studio and have a solid yoga with weights practice.

Cumbersome to navigate at times. I love core power on demand, but I have recommendations to make it better. 

1) somehow indicate in the menu which videos you have already watched. Maybe a check mark in the corner? Highlight it a different color?

2) be able to filter results better. For example, if I am looking for a 30min C2, it would be awesome to click enter the C2 menu and then filter it to show only the 30min C2 episodes
Best thing COVID did for me. I love being able to do these classes at my home when it works for me. The instructors are fabulous and I’ve learned so much. Thanks for creating this option!

good quality videos. I had a lot of material to learn from. If you are intermediate and want to advance your practice, this is limited. Some teachers are a little annoying, but they are knowledgable.

I did 3 months and wanted new material so I stopped my membership, not as much “new material every week” (as they advertise) that I wanted.

Thanks!
The worst. Customer service is non-existent. Emailed their “support” and never heard back. Not adding “new” hour-long classes frequently. I canceled after less than a month.

New Yogi. I love Core Power ondemand. I’m new to a yoga and with the current pandemic I couldn’t go to a studio. This app has been so helpful in getting me prepared for when classes reopen in studio.

Thanks,
Olivia

Great Voga. Surely miss the studios, but the high quality and wide selection courses are a great substitute during these strange times. Love their course series (doing 28 days to handstand now) as a great way to improve and track progress.

Needs work!. Can’t cancel a class that I’m waitlisted on which makes zero sense. Should have a visual for refreshing the list of classes when I’m trying to see if I’ve been added to a class after being waitlisted. Also the selected states of the location are not obvious which is actually selected. Needs work.
Love the classes. The online classes are perfect! So many to choose from. This is my main workout for everyday.
Always new content. Great at home workouts. Plenty to choose from all the time, doesn’t get old. A little pricy though

Feels like I’m in the real classes. I love how the Core Power online classes follow the same format as the in person classes. It gives me the flexibility to take classes when and where I want but with the same great work out.

KTEK, MD. The entire range of yogic meditation, stretching, and strength with many durations to choose from all in one app. My go to 👌🏻

Covid alternative. I was apprehensive at first, but once we settled into shelter in place this has become my go to app for exercise. Surprisingly sore post workout, the filter options are fantastic for narrowing down on the exercise type and class length.

Greatest online subscription. Great variety of classes and the different instructors. Love how I can pick session by time and get some on my mat without having to cut a full class short in a awkward way.
Amazing App. Well organized. Constantly updated. The classes are so well taught. So so happy I found this! I use it AT LEAST 3x a week!
Love to start my day with Core Power OnDemand :). So many class variations to choose from, great teachers and audio as well.
Great workout. Amazing workout and also great way to managing stress!
Great for on the go. The app works well and I love than you can download classes offline!

Great-Need More Classes or Live Stream Option. Have been using the app regularly since Covid, but am quickly running out of new classes. Would love to see new content or at least a live stream option.

Cons: 
Some instructors' aren't as good as others. I feel 2/3 of classes are great while the others are below expectations.
